title: 환희·브라이언, 열애설 재차 부인 "사귄 적은 없다"
caption:
After years of speculation, Hwanhee and Brian of Fly to the Sky address the rumors surrounding their relationship and a long-hidden vocal health struggle. The duo explains how mutual care helped them reunite.
